decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight was launched only in 2023, fits the firm's core modular lighting system, and was visibly committed to with its own product page, so management will attribute any weak early results to the normal ramp-up period and keep investing in it.

The LED ceiling luminaire is close to the established range and was presented on its own page, and the firm has invested in its planning files and dealer displays, so these sunk costs and the public commitment make withdrawing it after one year unlikely.
